title: Sphere recipe surface area over-counts 2.85x from surface-cell count; emitter pdf biased
body: BuildRecipeEmitterShapes sets A_recipe = N_surfaceCells*cellSize^2 (cell kept when min|sd| <= 0.5*sqrt3*cellSize). For a sphere this gives k_shape ~0.35 cells-to-area, i.e. area over-estimated ~2.85x vs the lightdesign k_shape~1, so the recipe-emitter pdf is ~2.85x too small and f/pdf is biased. Options: coarea-formula area estimate from jittered recipe evaluations at registration (recommended), per-recipe k_shape calibration, or accept the relaxation the design states.

title: MipFallback.glsl readMipSample indexes mipPoolBase in floats but CPU mipPoolBase is in MipSample (8 B) units
body: readMipSample uses mipPoolBase + (...)*2u (float-indexed) while the CPU mipPoolBase is counted in MipSample units. Probable multi-octree bug in the far-field read; the emitter power lane (EmitterSampling.glsl emitterLaneWord) is unaffected only because its hook is defined by the consumer. Reconcile to one unit.

title: Manual BodyInstance concat sites in BuildRenderGraph do not carry the emitter power lane
body: Demo concat sites around lines 3565, 4433, 4691, 5131, 5548 assemble ConcatenatedOctrees by hand and do not carry emitterPowerPool, so the emitterPowerPoolBaked flag stays 0 there. Harmless in S0 (nothing reads it); S1 needs one shared concat helper so every site gets the lane.
